# Tools by Melvin Jones Repol

> A collection of free, simple, and privacy-minded online tools for SEO, web development, networking, security, and everyday web tasks.

Website: https://tools.melvinjonesrepol.com/

Tools by Melvin Jones Repol provides focused web utilities designed to give useful results quickly without unnecessary accounts, dashboards, or complexity.

## Available Tools

### SEO & Web

- Open Graph Preview
  Preview Open Graph and social sharing cards before publishing a page.

- Meta Tag Checker
  Inspect and review webpage titles, descriptions, meta tags, and related metadata.

- Redirect Checker
  Follow a URL's HTTP redirect path and inspect redirect chains.

### Network & Security

- IP Address Lookup
  Look up information associated with an IP address.

- DNS Lookup
  Inspect common DNS records for a domain.

- Security Headers
  Review important HTTP security headers returned by a website.

### Developer Tools

- QR Code Generator
  Generate QR codes from text or URLs.

- JSON Formatter
  Format, validate, and clean up JSON data.

- Base64 Encoder
  Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 data.

- HTML Editor
  Edit HTML and preview the resulting page while you work.

## Purpose

The site is intended for developers, website owners, SEO professionals, system administrators, and other users who need quick web utilities.

Each tool focuses on a specific task and is designed to provide clear output without requiring a user account or complicated workflow.

## Topics

The site contains information and utilities related to:

- Search engine optimization
- Website metadata
- Open Graph metadata
- Social sharing previews
- HTTP redirects
- DNS records
- IP addresses
- HTTP security headers
- QR codes
- JSON
- Base64 encoding and decoding
- HTML editing and previewing
- Website troubleshooting
- Web development

## Usage

Tools may be used to inspect, validate, generate, format, or troubleshoot web-related information.

Results from diagnostic tools should be treated as informational. Users should independently verify results when making security, infrastructure, or other important technical decisions.

## Third-Party Resources

The site may reference external tools and services where they provide useful additional functionality, including:

- SecurityHeaders.com
- Website Carbon
- Schema.org Markup Validator

These external services are independent from Tools by Melvin Jones Repol.
